fixes.explanation: Yes, friend. The woman asks whom she should bring up, and Saul says, “Bring up Samuel…” Samuel, a prophet of the LORD (1 Samuel 3:20), had already died and been buried in Ramah (1 Samuel 28:3). He's the one Saul asks for by name.

Achish was the Philistine king of Gath (1 Samuel 27:2), friend, but he's not who Samuel names. Samuel says the LORD has torn the kingdom out of Saul's hand. The LORD gave it to “…your neighbor David.” It's David.
